# Installable Book

This site starts as direct HTML, CSS, and small JavaScript enhancements.

Preferred editing model:
- Edit the public HTML pages directly.
- Keep pages legible without JavaScript.
- Use `public/fragments/` for shared navigation and footer content.
- Use `public/http/get/*.json` for route and book metadata that can later move behind a backend.

High-value editable surfaces:
- `/index.html` landing page, install prompt, public positioning
- `/chapters/index.html` table of contents
- `/chapters/01-opening/index.html` first live chapter
- `/places/index.html`, `/items/index.html`, `/artifacts/index.html` bookmarkable route families
- `/fragments/site-nav.html`, `/fragments/site-footer.html` shared shell
- `/http/get/site.json`, `/http/get/book.json`, `/http/get/chapters.json` public metadata

PWA surfaces:
- `/manifest.webmanifest`
- `/sw.js`
- `/offline.html`

Conventions:
- Prefer `chapters/01-slug/` over `chapter/01`.
- Preserve route families even when pages are not materialized yet.
- Treat `enhancements.js` as progressive enhancement only.
- If adding a framework or backend later, preserve the public route contract first.
